about: Import choices for every humanoid clip, measured on the person's rig by `call clipimport` (Editor/Native/MVClipImport.cs). loop: last frame meets the first (major joints within 20 deg, mean 8, hips 5 cm). travelling: the body ends 0.5 m or more from where it began, or averages 0.35 m/s. choice: Loop Time and Bake Into Pose (rotation, Y, and XZ unless travelling) only on loops; Root Transform Position Y Based Upon Feet on every clip; footIK from footIKTest (Unity Foot IK on against off: on only if it cuts foot slide by a third with no knee moved past 25 deg). before: the settings it had.
